adminCategories.title: Exam categories
adminCategories.subtitle: These categories drive the “Exam preparation” storefront. Create categories (“International exams”, “Residency in Türkiye”) and subcategories inside them. Exams are assigned to categories on the “Exams” page.
adminCategories.empty: No categories yet. Create the first one — it will appear on the storefront.

form.name: Name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: A short note for the storefront

confirms.delete: Delete the category “{{name}}”? Exams themselves are not deleted, but the category must be empty.

adminImport.title: Import a test from a file
adminImport.subtitle: Upload a file with questions — PDF, Word, plain text or a scan. The model extracts the questions and answer options and sorts them into topics on its own. Nothing has to be marked up in advance.
adminImport.aiOff: File extraction is switched off. The server needs <1>ANTHROPIC_API_KEY</1> and <2>EDUCATION_EXTRACTOR=claude</2> in <3>.env</3>, then <4>pm2 restart all --update-env</4>. Until these variables are set, file upload will not work.

sourceKindHints.public_government: A government test or study guide that may be used for exam preparation. Name the issuing authority — without it the question cannot be published.
sourceKindHints.original: The file was prepared by your own authors.
sourceKindHints.licensed: The material was obtained under a contract. Describe the terms of use.
sourceKindHints.ai_generated: The questions were invented by the model rather than extracted from a source.

form.newProgramOption: ➕ New test — build it from the file
form.targetHintNew: The model derives the test title and sections from the file contents — you can adjust them afterwards.
form.targetHintExisting: The questions go into an existing test. Its sections are already defined, and the model will sort the questions into them.
form.countryHint: A two-letter country code, or INT for international tests.
form.sourceUrlHint: Optional. A website address — «https://» may be omitted. The file itself is not kept on the server, so the link is what lets you check against the original later.
form.licenseNotePlaceholder: What exactly may be used and under what conditions
form.dropzoneHint: PDF, Word (.doc, .docx), text (TXT, MD, CSV, HTML, RTF) or an image — up to 25 MB

drafts.title: Questions extracted: {{count}}
drafts.langNote: Question language: <1>{{lang}}</1>. This is the language that goes onto the test card and into the catalogue language filter.
drafts.attentionHint: For some questions the file gave no correct answer, or fewer than two options were extracted. The model does not guess them — mark the right option with the «this one is correct» button, or discard the question.
drafts.doneNotice: Moved to the bank: {{count}}. Two steps remain: <1>work through the review queue</1> and <2>publish the test itself</2>. Learners will see it only after both.

stages.extracting: The model is reading the file — this may take a few minutes…
stages.extractingPart: Extracting: part {{current}} of {{total}}… A large file is split and processed in parts.

notices.detected: Questions extracted: {{count}}. Check what was extracted and move what you need to the bank.
notices.imported: Moved to the bank: {{count}}. The questions were created as drafts and are waiting for review.
notices.importedWithSkipped: Moved to the bank: {{count}}. The questions were created as drafts and are waiting for review. Skipped {{skipped}}: {{list}}
notices.jobDeleted: The upload was removed from the list.
notices.partialExtraction: Not everything was extracted: {{failed}} of {{total}} parts failed (too dense). Move the rest as usual, and upload the skipped pages as a separate file into the same exam.

errors.sourceUrl: «Link to the original» must be a website address (for example, minzdrav.gov.ru or https://…). Leave the field empty if there is no link.
errors.authorityRequired: For borrowed material you must name the authority or publisher — without it the questions cannot be published.
errors.licenseRequired: For licensed material, state the terms of use.
errors.country: The country code is two letters (TR, SA, AZ) or INT.
errors.setCorrectKey: Could not set the correct answer

confirms.deleteJob: Delete the upload “{{name}}” from the list? The drafts extracted by this job will be lost.
confirms.deleteJobImported: Delete the upload “{{name}}” from the list? Questions already moved to the bank: {{count}} — they stay, only the extraction record disappears.

adminPrograms.title: Exams
adminPrograms.subtitle: Learners only see published exams. Publishing a question and publishing an exam are separate steps: you can build up questions for as long as you like, but you open the exam once, when it is ready.

actions.importFromFile: Import an exam from a file
actions.publishDisabledHint: Publish at least one question first
actions.hardDeleteHint: Deletes the exam and all of its questions with no way to restore them

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, code or authority…

empty.importFirst: Import the first one from a file →

warnings.noPublished: The exam has no published questions — there is nothing to publish.
warnings.noBlueprint: The exam has no sections. It will work, but the “mock exam” mode will be unavailable and readiness will not break down by topic.

settings.freeHint: show the badge on the card

hints.noCategoriesTail: so that exams are grouped on the storefront.

notices.published: Exam “{{title}}” is published — it now appears in the learners' catalog.
notices.restored: Exam “{{title}}” has been restored from the archive as a draft. Publish it once it is ready.
notices.blockSizeSet: Exam “{{title}}” is split into blocks of {{count}} questions.
notices.blockSizeOff: Block splitting for “{{title}}” is turned off.
notices.hardDeleted: Exam “{{title}}” has been deleted permanently (questions deleted: {{count}}).
notices.hardDeletedWithAttempts: Exam “{{title}}” has been deleted permanently (questions: {{items}}, attempts: {{attempts}}).

confirms.archive: Archive the exam “{{title}}”? Questions and completed attempts will be kept, but the exam will disappear from the catalog and from this list.
confirms.hardDelete: Delete the exam “{{title}}” PERMANENTLY together with all of its questions? This cannot be undone.
confirms.forceDelete: Delete the exam anyway, TOGETHER with its attempt history? This is irreversible.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load the list of exams
errors.statusFailed: Could not change the exam status
errors.blockSizeFailed: Could not save the block size
errors.blockSizeRange: Block size must be a number from 1 to 500 (or empty to turn splitting off).

adminReview.title: Question review
adminReview.subtitle: This is the only route by which questions reach learners. Explanations are not mandatory — you can publish right away and add the rationale later.
adminReview.emptyQueue: The queue is empty — everything has been reviewed.
adminReview.emptyQueueLink: Import a test from a file →
adminReview.selectPrompt: Pick a question from the list on the left
adminReview.machineBanner: This question came from machine extraction. Check the stem, the options and the correct answer against the original — extraction may have lost an option or mixed up the answer key.
adminReview.machineBannerWithConfidence: This question came from machine extraction (extraction confidence {{percent}}%). Check the stem, the options and the correct answer against the original — extraction may have lost an option or mixed up the answer key.
adminReview.explanationPlaceholder: Why the correct answer is correct: mechanism, criterion, reference to the guidelines
adminReview.warningsNote: {{list}}. You can publish it as it is — the learner will see the correct answer without a rationale. Explanations can be added later, and the question stays published.
adminReview.rejectLabel: Reject and return to the author
adminReview.rejectPlaceholder: Reason: what exactly is wrong and what needs fixing

blockers.noAuthority: no source is given (authority or publisher)

errors.loadQueue: Could not load the review queue
errors.rejectReasonRequired: State the reason for rejection — it goes back to the author

notices.published: The question is published. For learners to see the test, publish the test itself in the «Tests» section.
notices.rejected: The question was rejected and returned to the author
notices.bulkApprovedWithSkipped: Approved questions: {{count}}. Left in the queue: {{skipped}} — they have blockers.

bulk.title: Approve in bulk
bulk.hint: Approves every question of the exam that is ready to publish. Questions with blockers — no correct answer, no issuing authority — stay in the queue: they need a human look.

confirms.approveAll: Approve all ready questions of “{{name}}”? Currently in queue: {{count}}. Questions with blockers will stay unreviewed.

result.expired: The attempt was closed when the time ran out

runner.finishHint: Unanswered questions are counted as incorrect.

catalog.title: Exam preparation
catalog.subtitle: Practice, mock exams and answer review. Large exams can be taken in blocks — part by part instead of all questions at once.

search.placeholder: Search tests by title, awarding body or category…

empty.title: No published tests yet.
empty.hint: Add them in the admin panel: “Tests and exams” → “Upload test from file”.

noResults.withFilters: Nothing found for your query with the selected filters.

emptyFolder.byLang: There are no tests in “{{lang}}” here.
emptyFolder.plain: There are no tests in this category yet.

quota.title: Questions this month
quota.hint: Only answered questions count against the quota, not opened tests.
quota.guestHint: Trial run without signing up. Registration unlocks 250 questions a month.
quota.out: Quota used up. It resets at the start of the month, or immediately with Exam Prep.
quota.guestOut: Demo finished. Sign up — 250 questions a month, free.

inProgress.title: You have an unfinished attempt
inProgress.hint: You can start a new attempt on this program only after the current one has been finished.

topics.title: Topics
topics.note: A topic counts as assessed after 5 answers. While there is little data, readiness looks lower than it is — that is normal at the start of your preparation.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.hint: The exam is split into blocks of {{blockSize}} questions — work through it piece by piece instead of taking all {{totalCount}} questions at once. Each block can be taken separately, at a pace that suits you.
blocks.name: Block {{number}}

modeHints.tutor: Explanation right after every answer, no timer
modeHints.timed: The timer runs, explanations at the end
modeHints.mock: Composition strictly follows the topic blueprint, timer, final report
modeHints.drill: Extra practice on your three weakest topics

start.title: Start
start.titleWhole: Take the whole exam at once

adminGenerate.title: Generate an exam with AI
adminGenerate.subtitle: Give a topic and a number of questions — the model writes them. They land in the same drafts and go through review: they are never published without a human check.
adminGenerate.aiOff: Generation is unavailable: the Anthropic API key on the server is not set (the same one used for file extraction).

form.newProgramOption: ➕ New exam — build from the topic

form.sourceNotePlaceholder: e.g. inspired by the open USMLE bank
form.reviewNote: Generated questions always go through review before publishing — the model can get facts wrong.

stages.generating: The model is writing questions — this can take a few minutes…

notices.done: Generated questions: {{count}}. Review the drafts and move the ones you want to the bank.
notices.partial: Generated {{generated}} of {{requested}}: some batches failed. You can generate more into the same exam.
